protocol_version.description: Version of the Skillward Protocol this manifest conforms to.

id.description: Globally unique, human-readable skill identifier, e.g. 'word-count'.

description.description: Natural-language description used by orchestrators/LLMs for discovery and skill selection.

runtime.description: Execution runtime the payload targets. 'python3.1x' and 'node20' are executable code, dispatched to a sandboxed subprocess. 'text' is not code at all: the payload (a prompt, instructions, any static content, in the spirit of a SKILL.md) is returned verbatim with no execution and no capability surface. Chain calls ('skill:' capabilities) work identically across every runtime. Future versions may add more code runtimes and/or a wasm-component target.

entrypoint.description: For code runtimes: path within the payload plus the callable to invoke, e.g. 'payload.py:run' or 'payload.js:run' — the callable receives a single JSON-serializable dict and returns a JSON-serializable dict. For the 'text' runtime: a bare path with no callable, e.g. 'skill.md' or 'notes.txt' — there's nothing to call, the file's contents are the result.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the input dict passed to the entrypoint.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the output dict returned by the entrypoint.

capabilities.description: Declared permissions this skill requires. Orchestrators MUST deny anything not listed here. Empty array means fully sandboxed with no network/filesystem/chain-call access.

url.description: Where the orchestrator fetches the executable payload from.

sha256.description: Hex sha256 digest of the exact bytes served at payload.url. Orchestrators MUST verify this before execution.

signature.description: Optional base64 Ed25519 signature of the sha256 digest, verifiable against publisher.public_key.

account_id.description: Account that published this skill; set by the registry, not the publisher.

public_key.description: Optional base64 Ed25519 public key used to verify payload.signature.

visibility.description: 'public' skills are discoverable/fetchable by any authenticated account. 'private' skills are visible only to their owning account and any account listed in allowed_accounts.

allowed_accounts.description: Account ids granted access to a private skill, in addition to its owner. Ignored when visibility is 'public'.
